channel.title: Deployment :: Kwik5 Doc
channel.description: # Document gh workflow run gh-pages.yaml --repo kwiksher/kwik-visual-code --ref develop # lua_modules/kwiksher/resouces/template gh workflow run kwik-base-proj.yaml --repo kwiksher/kwik5-plugin --ref develop # UXP build main.js gh workflow run kwik-exporter.yaml --repo kwiksher/kwik-visual-code --ref develop # release .ccx gh workflow run release.yaml --repo kwiksher/kwik5-project-template --ref develop cd kwik5-plugin_build ./build.sh --debug --no-upload TODO # Photoshop/Solar2D gh workflow run kwik-base-proj.yaml --repo kwiksher/kwik5-sample-books --ref develop kwik5-plugin/kwik/test/github/release.http There are the two files kwik-exporter: com.kwiksher.kwik5.exporter_PS.ccx plugin.kwik: plugin.data.tgz kwik-visual-code: kwik-expoter
